{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyrXi7uQ3DY43QX24Rr6","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"OpenMP is now used unconditionally in `matmul/matmul.cpp` and `matmul/CMakeLists.txt`. The executable name is unchanged and no files were added. The build is clean with `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**What changed**\n- **CMakeLists.txt:** `find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)` and `target_link_libraries(matmul OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX m)`. The `m` library stays.\n- **`initMatrix`:** the outer loop is `#pragma omp parallel for`. Each element is independent.\n- **`matrixMultiply`:** rewritten as a tiled i-k-j kernel. The output is split into 16×64 tiles distributed with `collapse(2)`, so each thread owns whole tiles and no synchronization is needed. Within a tile, the k-loop is blocked by 256 and the inner j-loop uses `#pragma omp simd`.\n\nThis is more than a parallelization. The original's i-j-k loop walks B by column, which is cache-hostile, and that is where most of the speedup comes from. Per-element summation order is unchanged, so this is still the same arithmetic.\n\n**Correctness**\n- With `-ffp-contract=off`, the new program matches the original bit-for-bit across N = 1–70 and several larger sizes (127–1023).\n- The hash is identical for every thread count tested (1 to 256).\n- `-v` validation passes at every size I tried.\n- With the project's default flags, some N produce last-bit differences in the `-r` hash (e.g. N=17, 333, 1000). The original is not a consistent rounding sequence either. GCC unrolls its k-loop by 2, so the fused-multiply-add usage depends on N's parity. I couldn't make the new code match the original's exact bits for all N without disabling FMA. If you need the printed hashes to match the original exactly, add `-ffp-contract=off` to the compile options, at some cost in speed.\n\n**Performance** (N=1024, this machine reports 256 cores)\n- Original: 0.26 GFLOPS.\n- New, 1 thread: 4.8 GFLOPS. This gain is from loop order and vectorization, not threads.\n- New, 16 threads: 69 GFLOPS. 256 threads: 134 GFLOPS.\n\n**Caveats**\n- C is now zeroed inside the timed region, since each tile zeroes its own rows for first-touch placement. The original zeroed `C` before timing. The cost is N² writes against N³ compute, so it is small.\n- I built and ran in `/tmp` copies, not in the repo, to avoid leaving build directories behind. I did not test with clang or on other hardware.\n- This isn't a git repo, so I didn't commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":838,"cache_read_input_tokens":39712,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":838},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a7d74a06-3689-4f21-885b-7eeb35a552eb","uuid":"96d39d69-2a8e-4b2f-9134-f936721c484a","timestamp":"2026-10-13T07:38:21.254Z","request_id":"req_011CfyrXhYAqa5gJDqAzu1D1"}
